Title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova, et amplissima collectio, in qua praeter ea quae Phil. Labbeus et Gabr. Cossartius S.J. et novissime Nicolaus Coleti in lucem edidere, ea omnia insuper suis in locis optime disposita exhibentur, quae Joannes Dominicus Mansi evulgavit. Tomus Tertius
Creator: Giovanni Domenico Mansi (ed.), after Philippe Labbe, Gabriel Cossart and Nicolas Coleti
Publisher: Facsimile reproduction (anastatic process of C. Reinecke, Berlin) for H. Welter, editor, Paris and Leipzig, of the edition "expensis Antonii Zatta Veneti"; the imprint year of the original edition is not legible in the OCR
Publication Date: 1901 (the facsimile; the original edition of this volume is catalogued by archive.org as 1759)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: the 1901 facsimile is printed on the title-page image; the underlying edition is of the 18th century)
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item sacrorumconcilio0003phil (catalogue title "Sacrorum Conciliorum Nova, Et Amplissima Collectio.", volume 3, catalogue date 1759, language tag eng), full text at https://archive.org/download/sacrorumconcilio0003phil/sacrorumconcilio0003phil_djvu.txt. Fetched and opened directly 2026-09-30 by the lpc library sweep (second pass); the byte count of the downloaded file (3,806,327) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt. The title-page image was read: "Reproduction en fac-simile tirée à 250 exemplaires seulement par les procédés anastatiques de C. Reinecke, à Berlin, pour H. Welter, éditeur, ... Paris et à Leipzig ... 1901" (OCR of the same page: "Igor" at file line 217).
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected, so scan notices, library stamps and OCR errors remain as scanned. Rights basis: the 1901 facsimile date read on the title-page image places the printing out of US copyright under this project's pd-us-by-date rule; the text reproduced is that of the 1759 edition, older still.
Content note: The third volume of Mansi's conciliar collection. Title page in the OCR: "TOMUS TERTIUS." (file line 190) and "Ab ano CCCXEVIL. ad annum CCCCIX." (file line 271; the first year is damaged in the OCR, the syllabus that follows opens with the Council of Sardica in 347). African material by its own headings: "Concilium Carthaginense I. sub Grato" (file line 12680), "CONCILIUM CARTHAGINENSE" (file line 68353), the "CODEX CANONUM ... ECCLESIAE AFRICANAE" (file line 69478), "CONCILIUM HIPPONIENSE II." (file line 82431), "SYNODUS CARTHAGINENSIS AURELII" (file line 86419), "CONCILIUM AFRICANUM I. SUB ANASTASIO" (file line 93903), "CONCILIUM AFRICANUM III. SUB INNOCENTIO" (file line 110869). The volume ends with an Addenda section (file line 119472) and an Italian list of subscribers. It prints the Latin of the African canons that CCSL 149 (Munier) edits; whether it carries the Registri Ecclesiae Carthaginensis Excerpta was searched for ("registri", "regestri") and not found in this OCR. The OCR renders the long s as f (for example "Carthaginenfe"), so exact quotations need the page image.
